explication_en: The library fits in a single module lib/mock.ex that exposes Elixir macros such as with_mock and setup_with_mocks, and delegates module replacement to the Erlang library meck. Two test files, mock_test.exs and mock_setup_test.exs, check these macros after initialization by test_helper.exs.
